name: swipe
description: Performs a swipe gesture from start coordinates (startX, startY) to end coordinates (endX, endY) over the specified duration. Use this for scrolling lists, switching between tabs/pages, pulling to refresh, or dismissing notifications. The duration affects swipe speed: shorter duration = faster swipe (more momentum), longer duration = slower swipe (more controlled). Common patterns: vertical scroll up (startY > endY), scroll down (startY < endY), horizontal swipe left (startX > endX), swipe right (startX < endX).

endX.description: Ending X coordinate in pixels where the swipe finishes

endY.description: Ending Y coordinate in pixels where the swipe finishes

durationMs.description: Duration of the swipe gesture in milliseconds (default: 200). Increase for slower, more controlled swipes; decrease for quick flicks
